title: Dominated convergence for the action of an integer multiplicity triple under bounded pointwise-convergent multipliers
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let U ⊆ ℝ^P be any set, let R = (M, θ, ξ) be an integer multiplicity triple in U of dimension n (IMRep U n, with M = R.carrier, θ = R.mult, ξ = R.orient), and let ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U) (TestFormOn U n). Let h_k : ℝ^P → ℝ (k ∈ ℕ) be Borel measurable, let h : ℝ^P → ℝ be any function, and let C ∈ ℝ be such that |h_k(x)| ≤ C for all k and x and h_k(x) → h(x) as k → ∞ for every x ∈ ℝ^P. Then, with Hⁿ = μHE[n] and Bochner integrals, ∫_M θ(x)·h_k(x)·⟨ω(x), ξ(x)⟩ dHⁿ(x) → ∫_M θ(x)·h(x)·⟨ω(x), ξ(x)⟩ dHⁿ(x) as k → ∞, where ⟨ω(x), ξ(x)⟩ = R.orient x (ω x).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n) (ω : TestFormOn U n) (hs : ℕ → Euclid P → ℝ) (h : Euclid P → ℝ) (C : ℝ), (∀ k, Measurable (hs k)) → (∀ k x, |hs k x| ≤ C) → (∀ x, Tendsto (fun k => hs k x) atTop (𝓝 (h x))) → Tendsto (fun k => ∫ x in R.carrier, (R.mult x : ℝ) * hs k x * R.orient x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) ∂μHE[n]) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x in R.carrier, (R.mult x : ℝ) * h x * R.orient x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) ∂μHE[n]))
